description: Add (or with a negative number, remove) points for a listener on a RankFuel leaderboard. Needs the board id and its SECRET manage token. The listener is identified by public display name (+ optional town); a new name is added to the board automatically. PRIVACY: names are public, so use a first name plus last initial or a nickname; full names are shortened to "Jane S." and phone numbers or emails are rejected. Returns the listener's new total and rank and the top 10. Free, no key.

boardId.description: Leaderboard id (10 characters) or its public link, e.g. https://rfwin.uk/lb/abc123defg

listener.description: Public display name: first name + last initial, or a nickname/handle. No phone numbers or emails.

manageToken.description: SECRET manage token (rlb_…) returned once by create_leaderboard (the manage link also works). Keep private; never show it in public places.

reason.description: Optional short label, e.g. call-in, trivia, check-in (max 24 characters)

town.description: Optional town shown on the board; tells same-name listeners apart

name: add_points
